name: kourou_ela1
description: Guiana Space Centre, ELA-1, Kourou, French Guiana. Present only so the G1 credibility gate can drive the shipped compute_windows seam at a site with a published SSO launch. Not a product site.
longitude_convention: east-positive, converted from 52 deg 45 min 55 s W
coordinate_source: Vega launch site coordinates, east-positive. Confirmed by the launch-site azimuth implied by the published 98.18 deg sun-synchronous orbit and the reproduced launch time.

corridor.source: NOT A PUBLISHED CORRIDOR. Set wide enough to admit the azimuth implied by the published inclination, so the gate measures launch TIME rather than range acceptability.
